entries.spell_gangplankqwrapper_summary: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.
entries.spell_fling_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Max Health damage is capped at 300 against minions and jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_veigarr_summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
entries.spell_malzahare_summary:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.
entries.spell_malzaharw_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Voidlings deal @LaneMinionMod*100@% damage to lane minions affected by Malefic Visions.
Voidlings deal @EpicMonsterMod*100@% damage to epic monsters.
entries.spell_singedp_tooltip: Singed drafts off of nearby allied or enemy champions, gaining <speed>@MSPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed> for @MSDuration@ seconds. This effect has an @PerTargetCD@ second Cooldown per champion.
entries.spell_vir_tooltip:
Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them. Upon reaching them, Vi Knocks them Up for @RStunDuration@ seconds and deals @Damage@ physical damage.

Any other enemies Vi collides with are dealt damage, knocked aside, and Stunned for @SecondaryTargetStunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_tristanae_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Active damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at @CritChanceModifier*100@% effectiveness.
The detonation radius is twice as large if used on a turret.
entries.spell_vir_summary: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.
entries.spell_insanitypotion_summary: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
entries.spell_malzaharq_tooltip: Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Silencing</status> for @SilenceDuration@ second(s).
entries.spell_cassiopeiae_summary: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.
entries.spell_gangplanke_tooltipextendedbelowlin: <rules>Keg decay rate increases at level 7 and 13.</rules>
entries.spell_gate_tooltip: Teleports Twisted Fate to target location in 1.5 seconds.
entries.spell_wildcards_tooltip: Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each.
entries.spell_gangplankr_tooltip:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire @TotalWavesTooltip@ waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Each wave Slows by @SlowPercent@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds and deals @OneWaveDamage@ magic damage. Maximum damage: @TotalDamageTooltip@

This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}}.

Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs.
Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals @DeathsDaughterDamage@ true damage and Slows by @DeathsDaughterSlow@% for @DeathsDaughterSlowDuration@ second.
Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain @RaiseMoraleHaste@% Move Speed for @RaiseMoraleHasteDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_vie_tooltip:
Vi's next Attack deals @TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage to the target and enemies behind them.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
entries.spell_tristanar_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>If this Ability applies the final stack of <spellName>{{Spell_TristanaE_Name}}</spellName>, it explodes after the unit is <status>Knocked Back</status>.</rules>
entries.spell_chronoshift_tooltipextendedbelowli: <rules>Units in Stasis cannot move or act, and are invulnerable and Untargetable.</rules>
entries.spell_veigarpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_VeigarPassive_Tooltip}}

Veigar's evil is currently granting him @f1@ Ability Power
entries.game_character_passivetooltipextended_ca:
Cassiopeia gains @TotalMovementSpeed@ Move Speed and @BonusAbilityPower@ Ability Power but cannot purchase Boots.

This passive has been enhanced by claiming the Feats of Strength.
entries.spell_malzahare_tooltip:
Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains @ManaRestore@ Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below @MinionExecuteThreshold@ Health.
entries.spell_cardmasterstack_summary: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.
entries.spell_zacpassivechunkdrop_tooltipextende:
{{Spell_ZacPassiveChunkDrop_Tooltip}}

Each bloblet has 12% of Zac's max Health, and 50% of his Armor and Magic Resist.
entries.spell_tristanapassive_summary: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.
entries.spell_gangplankr_summary: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.
entries.spell_viq_summary: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.
entries.spell_wildcards_summary: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
entries.spell_malzaharpassive_tooltip: Malzahar gains @DRPercent@% damage reduction and immunity from <status>Disabling</status> and <status>Immobilizing</status> effects, lingering for @LingerDuration@ seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects. This effect has a @ShieldCooldown@ second Cooldown.
entries.spell_insanitypotion_tooltip: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him @StatAmount@ <scaleAP>Ability Power</scaleAP>, <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor>, <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, <speed>Move Speed</speed>, <healing>Health Regen</healing>, and <scaleMana>Mana Regen</scaleMana> for @Duration@ seconds. During this effect, Singed's <spellName>Poison Trail</spellName> also applies @GrievousAmount*100@% Grievous Wounds for @GrievousDuration@ second.
entries.spell_zileanw_summary: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.
entries.spell_zacw_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Percent Health damage against minions and jungle monsters is capped at 200.</rules>
entries.spell_timewarp_tooltip: Zilean <status>Slows</status> an enemy champion by @SpeedAmount@% or grants an allied champion <speed>@SpeedAmount@% Move Speed</speed> for @Duration@ seconds.
entries.spell_gangplankw_summary: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.
entries.spell_poisontrail_summary: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.
entries.spell_pickacard_summary: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
entries.spell_cassiopeiaq_tooltip: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, <keywordMajor>Poisoning</keywordMajor> enemies and dealing <magicDamage>@TooltipTotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoisonDuration@ seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia <speed>@ChampHitMSBonus@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @ChampHitMSDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_veigardarkmatter_summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.
entries.spell_tristanae_tooltip:
Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal @PassiveDamage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals @ActiveDamage@ physical damage to surrounding enemies after @ActiveDuration@ seconds. The damage is increased by @ActivePerStackAmp*100@% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks).

At @ActiveMaxStacks@ stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max @ActiveMaxDamage@ physical damage).
entries.spell_pickaacard_tooltipextended:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
  • The Blue Card deals @ttBlueDamage@ = (@BlueBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttBlueAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @BlueCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage and restores @Effect6Amount@ Mana.
  • The Red Card deals @ttRedDamage@ = (@RedBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttRedAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @RedCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows by @Effect2Amount@% for 2.5 seconds.
  • The Gold Card deals @ttGoldDamage@ = (@GoldBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttGoldAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @GoldCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage and Stuns for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.
entries.spell_chronoshift_summary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.
entries.spell_gangplankpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_GangplankPassive_Tooltip}}

Deals @TurretDamageMult*100@% damage to turrets.
{{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} does not apply this Ability.
entries.spell_veigareventhorizon_summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.
entries.spell_viq_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Non-champions hit are pulled towards Vi.
If the charge is interrupted, this Ability goes on a 3 second Cooldown.
entries.spell_zacq_tooltip:
Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal @TotalDamage@ magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow.

If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take @TotalDamage@ magic damage and are briefly Slowed.
entries.spell_tristanae_summary: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.
entries.spell_zacpassivechunkdrop_tooltip:
Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore @HealPercent@ Max Health.

Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after @ReviveBlobletDuration@ seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a @ReviveCooldown@ second Cooldown.
entries.spell_tristanapassive_tooltip: Tristana's Attack Range and the range of <spellName>{{Spell_TristanaE_Name}}</spellName> and <spellName>{{Spell_TristanaR_Name}}</spellName> are increased by @BonusPassiveRange@.
entries.spell_vie_summary: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.
entries.spell_zacw_tooltip:
Zac's body erupts, dealing @BaseDamage@ + @DisplayPercentDamage@ max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.
entries.spell_cassiopeiaw_tooltip: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for @CloudDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the clouds take <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second, are <keywordMajor>Poisoned</keywordMajor>, <status>Grounded</status>, and <status>Slowed</status> by @SlowPercent@%.
entries.spell_tristanaw_summary: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.
entries.spell_timewarp_summary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.
entries.spell_malzaharpassive_summary: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
entries.spell_malzaharw_tooltip:
Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max @StackCap@).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last @VoidlingDuration@ seconds and deal @VoidlingBonusDamageTooltip@ magic damage each hit.
entries.spell_zileanw_tooltip: Zilean turns time, reducing his other basic Ability Cooldowns by @CooldownReduction@ seconds.
entries.spell_zace_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Can be cancelled by moving.
If cancelled, refunds half of the Ability's Cooldown and cost.
entries.spell_pickacard_tooltip:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
  • The Blue Card deals @BlueDamage@ magic damage and restores @Effect6Amount@ Mana.
  • The Red Card deals @RedDamage@ to nearby enemies and Slows by @Effect2Amount@% for 2.5 seconds.
  • The Gold Card deals @GoldDamage@ and Stuns for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.
entries.spell_poisontrail_tooltipextendedbelowli:
Cloud duration: @CloudDuration@ seconds.
Poison duration: @PoisonDuration@ seconds.
Approximate total damage: @ApproximateTotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage.
If a minion would be killed by minion damage while under the effects of Poison Trail, Singed claims the kill credit instead.
entries.spell_megaadhesive_tooltip: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, <status>Grounding</status> and <status>Slowing</status> enemies in the area by @SlowPercent@% for @WDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_tristanar_tooltip: Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the target, <status>Knocking Back</status> and <status>Stunning</status> them and surrounding enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_heightenedlearning_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_HeightenedLearning_Tooltip}}

Total awarded: @TotalXP@ Experience.

Experience can't be granted in combat.
entries.spell_malzaharq_summary: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.
entries.spell_cassiopeiaq_summary: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.
entries.spell_vipassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_ViPassive_Tooltip}}

This Ability has a @ShieldCooldown@ second Cooldown, reduced by @CDReductionOn3Hit@ seconds when Vi triggers Denting Blows.
entries.spell_fling_tooltip:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing @BaseDamage@ plus @MaxHPDamage@% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his {{Spell_MegaAdhesive_Name}}, they are Rooted for @RootDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_secondsight_summary: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.
entries.spell_singedp_summary: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.
entries.spell_veigareventhorizon_tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for @StunDuration@ seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.
entries.spell_cassiopeiae_tooltip:
Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing @BasicDamage@ magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional @BonusPoisonedDamage@ magic damage and Cassiopeia restores @HealCalc@ Health, reduced to @HealCalcMinion@ Health against lane minions and small monsters.

If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores @Cost@ Mana.
entries.spell_veigardarkmatter_tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.
entries.spell_gangplankqwrapper_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Tooltip_@GameModeInteger@}}

Total Gold plundered: @f1@ Gold
Total SS plundered: @f3@ Silver Serpents
entries.game_character_passivedescription_cassio: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.
entries.spell_zacr_summary: Zac bounces four times, knocking up enemies hit and slowing them.
entries.spell_chronoshift_tooltip: Zilean grants a protective time rune to an allied champion for @RDuration@ seconds. If the target would die, the rune rewinds their timeline, putting them into Stasis for @ReviveStateDuration@ seconds, then reviving them and restoring <healing>@RTotalHeal@ Health</healing>.
entries.spell_veigarbalefulstrike_summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.
entries.spell_zace_summary: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.
entries.spell_megaadhesive_summary: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.
entries.spell_viw_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Deals a maximum of <physicalDamage>@MonsterDamageCap@ damage</physicalDamage> against jungle monsters.</rules>
entries.spell_poisontrail_tooltip: <toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals <magicDamage>@DamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second.
entries.spell_viw_summary: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.
entries.spell_tristanaq_summary: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.
entries.spell_malzaharpassive_tooltipextended:
{{Spell_MalzaharPassive_Tooltip}}

Taking damage will restart the Cooldown.
Damage from minions is not reduced, but it does not trigger or restart the Cooldown.
entries.spell_tristanar_summary: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.
entries.spell_tristanaw_tooltip:
Tristana launches herself, dealing @LandingDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowMod*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds upon landing.

Champion takedowns and max stack {{Spell_TristanaE_Name}} detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
entries.spell_veigarr_tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
entries.spell_tristanaq_tooltip: Tristana goes full-auto, gaining <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedMod*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_vipassive_tooltip: Vi gains <shield>@TotalShield@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds after hitting an enemy or structure with an activated Ability.
entries.spell_heightenedlearning_summary: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.
entries.spell_viq_tooltip:
Begin Charging: Vi begins charging a powerful punch, Slowing herself by @SelfSlow@%.

Release: Vi dashes forward dealing between @TotalDamage@ and @MaxDamageTooltip@ physical damage based on charge time and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Vi stops upon colliding with an enemy champion, and Knocks them Back.
entries.spell_cassiopeiar_summary: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.
entries.spell_malzaharw_summary: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.
entries.spell_malzaharr_summary: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.
entries.spell_cardmasterstack_tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Twisted Fate gains <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedBonus@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and every 4th Attack deals an additional <magicDamage>@BonusDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
entries.spell_malzaharr_tooltip: Malzahar <status>Suppresses</status> an enemy champion and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> over @CCDuration@ seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing <magicDamage>@ZoneDamageTooltip@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> over @PoolDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_destiny_tooltip:
Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for @Effect1Amount@ seconds and allowing him to Recast.

Recast: Twisted Fate teleports up to @Effect4Amount@ units away.
entries.spell_gangplankpassive_summary: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.
entries.spell_zileanq_tooltip:
Zilean tosses a time-delayed bomb that sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After @FuseDuration@ seconds it detonates, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Placing a second bomb on a unit that already has one detonates the first bomb immediately and Stuns enemies in the blast for @StunDuration@ seconds.
entries.spell_gangplankpassive_tooltip:
Gangplank's melee Attacks ignite the target, dealing an additional @TotalDamage@ true damage over @DoTDuration@ seconds and granting Gangplank @MoveSpeed@ Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes this Cooldown and grants Gangplank the same Move Speed.
entries.spell_gangplanke_tooltip:
Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for @BarrelDuration@ seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by @FinalSlowAmount@% for @DebuffDuration@ seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring @BarrelArmorPenetration@% Armor. Champions take an additional @BonusDamageToChampions@ physical damage.

Keg health decays every @BarrelDecayTime@ seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.
entries.spell_zacr_tooltip:
Zac bounces @Bounces@ times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals @DamagePerBounce@ magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal @DamagePerSubsequentBounce@ magic damage and Slow by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

Zac gains up to @EndingMS*100@% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.
entries.spell_zace_tooltip:
Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over @ChannelTime@ seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to @MaxStun@ second (based on charge time), dealing them @Damage@ magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.
entries.spell_vipassive_summary: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.
entries.game_character_passivedescription_cassio: Cassiopeia gains <speed>@TotalMovementSpeed@ Move Speed</speed> and <scaleAP>@BonusAbilityPower@ Ability Power</scaleAP> but cannot purchase Boots.
entries.spell_fling_summary: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.
entries.spell_cassiopeiaw_summary: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.
entries.game_character_passivetooltip_cassiopeia: Cassiopeia increases the effectiveness of all <speed>Move Speed</speed> bonuses by @PercentHasteMod@.
entries.spell_gangplankw_tooltip: Gangplank consumes a large amount of citrus fruit, removing all <status>Disabling</status> effects and restoring <healing>@BaseHealth@ plus @PercentHeal@% missing Health</healing>.
entries.spell_veigarpassive_summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.
entries.spell_zacw_summary: Zac explodes outward towards nearby enemies, dealing a percentage of their maximum health as magic damage.
entries.spell_wildcards_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>Enemies can only be damaged by one of the cards.</rules>
entries.spell_zacr_tooltipextendedbelowline:
Total Damage: @MaxDamageTooltip@ magic damage
Move Speed increases from @BeginningMS*100@% to @EndingMS*100@% over the duration.
During Let's Bounce!, Zac is Ghosted. Ghosted units ignore collision with other units.
entries.spell_veigarbalefulstrike_tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.
entries.spell_viw_tooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Every 3rd Attack on the same target deals an additional <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ max Health physical damage</physicalDamage>, removes <scaleArmor>@ShredAmount@% Armor</scaleArmor> and grants Vi <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeed@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for @SharedBuffsDuration@ seconds. It also reduces the remaining Cooldown of <spellName>Blast Shield</spellName> by @spell.ViPassive:CDReductionOn3Hit@ seconds.
entries.spell_zileanq_summary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.
entries.spell_gangplankqwrapper_tooltipextendedb: <rules>The shot applies On-Hit effects (other than <spellName>{{Spell_GangplankPassive_Name}}</spellName>) and can critically strike for <physicalDamage>@ShotCrit@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.</rules>
entries.spell_gangplanke_summary: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.
entries.spell_cassiopeiar_tooltip: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing <magicDamage>@RDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> enemies facing her for @RCCDuration@ seconds. Enemies facing away are <status>Slowed</status> by @RSlowPercent@% decaying over the same duration instead.
entries.spell_zacq_summary: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.
entries.spell_zileanq_tooltipextendedbelowline: <rules>The bomb will prioritize attaching to champions and units that already have a bomb.</rules>
entries.spell_veigarpassive_tooltip:
Veigar's Abilities grant him @dAbilityStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional @dTakedownStacks@ stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar @APPerStack@ Ability Power.
entries.spell_destiny_summary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
